data.long_meaning: Baji is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Bhagat', meaning 'devotee' or 'worshiper'. The name Baji is associated with Lord Vishnu, the preserver in Hindu mythology, and symbolizes wealth, prosperity, and the blessings of the deity. The name Baji carries the meaning “Lord of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Baji usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
